description: Calendar of scheduled crypto token unlocks in the next N days (up to 60), each rated strong / medium / small by size relative to circulating supply. Use for questions like 'which token unlocks are coming this week', 'biggest unlocks in November', 'strong unlocks with perpetual futures'. Data refreshes hourly (data_updated_utc in the result). Results are cut to 'limit' (default 30): 'matched' says how many fit the filters. The futures filter covers KuCoin and Binance USDT perpetuals only. For one coin use get_token_unlocks; for what the rating means and past results use get_method_and_track_record; for coverage and sources use get_dataset_info. lang=ru returns Russian page links.

sort.description: date = soonest first; size = largest share of circulating supply first.
